discounts.description: 25% off any spectacle lenses. Per backend: Included Group #1 = 'Items type - Lenses for glasses' only. 'Only for complete glasses' checkbox is unchecked. Infinity uses.
discounts.notes: Lens-only discount. Backend value = 25% off lens portion, but our runner observes % off basket total (frame 899 + BASIC lens 498 = 1397; 25% of 498 = 124.50; 124.50/1397 = 8.91%). value=8.88 is the empirical observation. If alensa changes the BASIC lens price or this discount's % rate, the observed % shifts and this will FAIL — that's correct behaviour. To re-calibrate, run the test once, read 'observed %' from the report, update value to match.
